title: Click-track fixture, click finder and features/link/STEPS.md for the clock specs
description:
## Intent
The ground the M1 specs stand on: a click-track fixture and the step vocabulary for `features/link/`.

## Steps
1. `crates/apricity-engine/tests/fixtures/clock/click.apricity.json`: a sample manifest (valid against `schema/sample-manifest.schema.json`) for a 4-bar 4/4 click at 100 BPM, beats and downbeats every 0.6 s, warp markers on each beat.
2. `crates/apricity-engine/tests/fixtures/clock/click.apr`: the click score (one track, 4 bars).
3. A test helper that writes the WAV at test time with `hound` into a temp dir (accented beat 1), so no audio enters git.
4. A test helper that finds clicks in rendered output (onset frame, loudness) and converts frames to clock beats.
5. `features/link/STEPS.md`: the normative step table (State, Given, When, Then), in the style of `features/sources/STEPS.md`: scripted clock, the click score, "within the tolerance".

## Verify
`cargo test -p apricity-engine --test clock` builds and the helpers' own unit tests pass; a test validates `click.apricity.json` against `schema/sample-manifest.schema.json` (the same way the analysis tests validate manifests: `(cd analysis && PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests -k schema)`), and `git status` shows no `.wav` added.

Commit: `chore(<this task id>): click fixture and link step vocabulary`.

## Protocol
Specs first, watched red; log decisions, problems and outcomes with `kbs comment`; run Verify and paste the tail. Every Bash call starts `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH && cd /Users/home/Projects/Apricity`; cargo with `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 RUST_TEST_THREADS=2` under `safe-run.sh --`. Never change dependencies to make a build pass. Sub-agents never commit, push or close.
